scope: All previously tested segmentation methods rerun on both complete Zhang H&E sections. Benchmark only: no RCTD, no reference promotion, no automatic winner.
common_assignment: Original bin centre, using original native fullres coordinates times original hires scale. Entire integer UMI vector assigned once; outside-image and background bins remain unassigned. No inferred transcript positions.

learned_variants.name: Cellpose3
learned_variants.input: hematoxylin uint8; bright nuclear signal, no invented DNA

learned_variants.name: InstanSeg_HE
learned_variants.input: original RGB H&E; original calibrated microns per pixel

learned_variants.name: microSAM_LM_AMG
learned_variants.input: PIL L conversion of original H&E; original benchmark thresholds

learned_variants.name: PathoSAM_HE_AIS
learned_variants.input: original RGB H&E; official tiled AIS

method_notes: The old nominal 4.5 um seed setting rounded to the same pixel spacing as 3.5 um on both sections: verify and report aliases, do not count duplicate settings as independent methods.
Nuclear masks and 5um-expanded masks are separate variants, not equivalent targets.
The original Du inputs were protein composites. Here all methods use Zhang H&E; interface-specific preprocessing is explicit.
No boundary ground truth or molecule coordinates are distributed: no invented accuracy, fusion rate, CellSPA score or recovered single-cell transcript counts.
